decision: D1: version the amended suitability judgment and bind its template
recommended: JudgeCandidate-v2 for new dispatches; historical v1 records remain readable and replayable
authority_requested: Implement and offline-verify this bounded amendment; no paid study, grant reuse, promotion, merge or deployment
current_contract: JudgeCandidate-v1-only fields in JudgmentPolicy and JudgmentRecord; seven derived public schemas
changes: New live dispatch policies and emitted judgment records use JudgeCandidate-v2; an active v1 policy cannot silently dispatch the changed template.
Historical JudgmentRecord v1 payloads remain valid for stored inspection/replay; preserve all 14 stopped-study receipts byte-for-byte.
Bind the rendered suitability request-template digest and explicit projection version into development judge configuration revision, study validator expectation, and product route cache identity.
Apply the final R2 selected-profile projection before binding its template, so new dispatches describe one stable version.
Regenerate SDK and boundary schemas with pinned BAML 0.20.1; update interfaces, decisions and relevant v2 fixtures/tests.
Retain existing collection policy, allowance gates, unknown quality/cost semantics and empirical blockers.
verification: v2 dispatch and policy/record binding; fail closed on new v1 dispatch attempts
legacy v1 artifact parsing and immutable replay
prompt/projection digest changes invalidate cross-request cached results and judgment configuration; unchanged template preserves identity
targeted telemetry, exact-profile, baseline and replay tests; generation, lint, types, package and configured companion checks
dissenting-seat delta reviews and new manual Opus 5.5 president ruling
alternative: Explicitly amend v1 in place with identical digest bindings and documentation; retains current schema constants but leaves historical/current v1 labels with different meanings.

instruction_source.quote: Do not silently retain JudgeCandidate-v1 if judgment semantics change: stop for an explicit versioned amendment on parity failure.

scope_boundaries: No revisions to study attribution, cheapest-model validator policy, provider allow-list policy, abstention collection policy, protocol cases or release holdouts.
